comment: Every GitHub App private key a canonical workflow binds, and how that binding is confined. An organization or repository secret is readable by any workflow on any non-fork ref, so only an environment secret whose deployment-branch policy admits main alone confines the key (issue 1285, ADR 0166, ADR 0171, ADR 0179). scripts/ci-gate/app-key-environment.test.py enumerates .github/workflows and fails when this declaration and the workflow directory disagree in either direction.

Bound with no environment by capability-floor-observe, dependency-supersession-observe, dependency-supersession-reconcile, renovate-compatibility-reconcile and renovate-grouping-plan, and held at organization visibility all, so any non-fork ref of any granted repository can read it. Binding the environment before the operator provisions renovate-compatibility-app with an exact main-only policy would create an unprotected environment and assert a confinement that does not exist, so the binding waits for provisioning.
